This is the worst hotel I have ever stayed in. The room walls were dirty, and the refrigerator did not work. The television was also not functioning, and the electric kettle was so dirty inside that it was not even usable. The telephone was not working either, and the hotel staff did not take our complaints seriously.
The most disappointing part was seeing a staff member clean both the plates and the table with the same cloth, which was very unhygienic.
I would strongly recommend that others avoid staying at this hotel.

Very disappointing stay. The intercom, refrigerator, television, and WiFi were all not working, even after several complaints. Basic amenities were missing, and the staff did not resolve the issues. Not recommended.

Hotel is not good for more than 1 day stay. Hotel do not allow food from outside, basically looting the customers for food also. The food is very costly what they provide. Wifi never works. The service staff is good. Receptionist and managing staff is very rude.
